items.title: Postgres 19 REPACK: Built-In Online Table Bloat Cleanup
items.blurb: Discover Postgres 19 REPACK and REPACK (CONCURRENTLY). Learn how to reclaim bloated table space online without downtime, external extensions, or table locks.

items.title: Burnt TOAST: Why DBAs Dread Large Text Columns
items.blurb: Shaun Thomas on how PostgreSQL TOAST stores large columns, when it speeds up scans and updates, and where splitting a table or switching to lz4 helps - with benchmarks.

items.title: Getting Rid of a 4 Terabyte Table Efficiently
items.blurb: Dropping a large table writes 80 KB of WAL, then stalls replay on every replica while the files are unlinked: 16 s for a cold 1 TB table on ext4, 80 ms on XFS.

items.title: How Flink's Kafka connector commits offsets to Kafka
Sub-Second Personalization on One Lakehouse
items.blurb: Personalization is only as good as the freshness of the data behind it. This webinar demos how EDB Postgres AI Analytics delivers sub-second next-best-action on a single copy of data, using Apache Iceberg tables shared through one catalog.
